zh.summary: 把采访录音变成可搜索、可协作文字的专业转写工具。
zh.judgment: 转写本身容易替代；可持续收费要依赖隐私、团队资料管理与完整采访工作流。
zh.replaces: 记者和研究人员反复听录音、手工做采访文字并在文件夹中整理素材。
zh.product: 官网展示录音转写、说话人识别、摘要、项目整理与团队协作。产品入口清晰，但从转写到可靠引用仍需要用户核对原音；不能把自动文字当成没有误差的采访证据。
zh.customer: 潜在用户是记者、研究者与需要处理敏感录音的专业团队，采购者可能是个人或机构，此为商业推断。高频任务能支持持续购买，但偶尔转写用户可能只需要免费或按次工具，客户群要分开评估。
zh.workflow: 官网描述从录音或上传到转写和项目整理的链路。分析上应核验说话人与时间片段对应、错误修订和团队分享权限，让文字能够回到原始音频；这些能力比单次演示的速度更影响长期信任。
zh.business_model: 已核验 Explore 附加功能的发布优惠：当前在各方案中免费，发布期后列为每月 10 欧元或年付折合 8 欧元。它不是完整转写套餐的统一价格；基础方案与企业合同仍需确认，音频处理和存储成本应分别计算。
zh.traction: 官网有客户案例与安全声明，均属于公司披露，不等于独立审计或普遍效果。缺少付费用户留存、音频使用频率和校对工时分布，因而不能单从“节省时间”推出成熟单位经济。
zh.moat: 通用模型、会议工具与本地转写都能提供基础替代。潜在优势在专业工作流、敏感素材处理与团队资料积累；只有当这些让用户持续回到产品，而不是导出一次就离开，才可能提高留存。
zh.funding_read: 本轮金额与具体轮次未披露，应保留这个边界，不用投资方推算金额或估值。下一商业里程碑可看团队账户续费、从录音入口到协作的持续使用，以及重度账户的实际利润。
zh.risks: 复杂音频中的文字与说话人错误可能增加校对；基础转写价格下行可能侵蚀付费意愿。若专业安全诉求没有带来可验证的采购优势，独立产品也可能被通用工具替代。
zh.takeaway: 可借鉴从清晰单任务进入，再围绕专业素材建立连续工作流。对创作工具，最好把“生成结果”接到保存、检索、协作和核对，观察这些后续动作是否真的提高续费。
zh.watch_next: 看付费团队续费、每次转写后的校对分钟、活跃项目与音频处理毛利。还应比较只用转写与使用团队协作的客户留存，确认后续功能是否确实创造增量价值。

en.summary: A professional transcription tool connecting interview recordings with searchable team material.
en.judgment: Transcription is substitutable; privacy, archives and complete interview workflows must sustain payment.
en.replaces: Repeated listening, manual transcription and scattered interview files.
en.product: The site presents transcription, speaker labels, summaries and project collaboration. Users still need to check original audio before relying on quotations, rather than treating generated text as error-free evidence.
en.customer: Journalists, researchers and professional teams are plausible users, with individual or institutional buyers. This is an inference. Frequent work differs commercially from occasional transcription that may fit free or per-use tools.
en.workflow: The stated path connects capture or upload with transcription and project organisation. Evaluation should examine audio traceability, corrections and sharing permissions, which affect sustained trust beyond demo speed.
en.business_model: The reviewed Explore launch offer is currently free across plans; listed post-launch rates are €10/month or €8 with annual billing. This is not a complete transcription-plan price. Base plans and enterprise terms still need confirmation; processing and storage require separate costing.
en.traction: Company cases and security statements are not independent audits or universal outcomes. Paid retention, usage frequency and correction time remain important evidence gaps.
en.moat: Generic models, meeting tools and local transcription offer substitutes. Professional workflows and accumulated team material might help retain customers, but only if they return rather than export once and leave.
en.funding_read: Amount and specific stage are undisclosed. The investor does not reveal valuation or cheque size. Team renewals and profitable recurring use would be useful commercial milestones.
en.risks: Difficult recordings and attribution errors can increase correction work. Falling basic-transcription prices may weaken willingness to pay. Professional safeguards need a demonstrable procurement advantage.
en.takeaway: Enter through a clear task, then build a recurring workflow around the material. Saving, searching, collaboration and verification should be tested for their contribution to renewals rather than assumed valuable.
en.watch_next: Watch team renewals, correction minutes, active projects and processing margin. Compare retention for transcription-only users with collaborating teams to test the incremental value of the wider workflow.
